title: Stop Saying "Very Rich"! 4 Better Ways to Say It #shorts
description:
Don't say "very rich". Say one of these instead:
• Wealthy: He's wealthy!
• Affluent: They live in an affluent area.
• Loaded: My uncle is loaded.
• The idiom: He's rolling in money!
